summary: Compiled with /target:winexe (GUI subsystem) so the launcher itself has no console, as an independently-built proxy for how Electron apps (Claude Code/Cursor) spawn subprocesses on Windows — distinct from testing via Node's own detached spawn. Sets CreateNoWindow=true when launching node, and THAT turned out to be the reason its A/B test came back inconclusive: CreateNoWindow/windowsHide most likely gives the launched process a HIDDEN console rather than no console at all, so node's own downstream execFileSync child (ping.exe, standing in for git) just reuses that hidden console instead of requesting a new one — regardless of whether the inner call itself sets windowsHide. Fire-and-forget (no WaitForExit) since the caller needs to start polling immediately, not after the ~2s harness run already finished.
